description: A tool designed for breaking up rocks and hard surfaces. Consists of a wooden handle with a pointed metal head. Essential for mining operations and can be used to break through stone walls.
name: Pickaxe
notes: Works a rock face at a mining seam: iron and copper. Harder ore needs a better pick (the Forgemistress in Ironpeak forges them).
Wears as you swing it. A worn pick costs you swings; a crafting kit or a smith puts it right.
